title: Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation

paragraphs: This Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation reviews ownership, corporate structure, brand and operator relationships, people, portfolio context, and development implications for Sheraton Guadalajara Expo. Evidence is compiled from the completed Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation and supporting public sources.
Brand resolution: Current Marriott Sheraton flag (GDLSE). Franchise posture PROBABLE — franchise agreement not obtained.
Current operator reading: Aimbridge LATAM (CURRENT; HIGH). Former operator: CAPITALI Grupo Hotelero.
Property company reading: Inmobiliaria HNF, S. de R.L. de C.V.. Economic / package owner reading: HNF / Newton family sphere.
Franchise Sheraton with confirmed Aimbridge operator and strong HNF PropCo evidence — owner/operator/brand separation archetype for Mexico Explorer demo.

Material open questions remain (11) — including deed/title, decision authority, brand/operator contracts, and capital structure where not established. Unresolved items are listed explicitly rather than inferred.

Methodology: owner ≠ operator ≠ brand. Titles are not signing authority. Findings are research-grade and are not auto-applied to master property records. This dossier is the primary Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation for the hotel.

paragraphs: This chapter establishes the focus hotel for the Full Hotel Intelligence Investigation and guards against adjacent-asset confusion in the same market corridor.
Focus hotel: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo, Av. Mariano Otero 1510, Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico.
Do not confuse with voco Guadalajara Expo / Neruda, other Expo-corridor hotels, or other Sheraton Mexico properties.
Published address evidence supports Av. Mariano Otero 1510, Rinconada del Sol, Zapopan, Jalisco, Mexico 45055.
Room inventory is assessed at 216 rooms/suites with HIGH confidence (Marriott + Aimbridge LATAM listings (earlier coverage cited 215)).
Product posture: Upper upscale full-service / Expo corridor — First Sheraton in Guadalajara (Marriott Jan 2024 announcement context).

Physical / identity history summary: Construction from 2019 (~US$28M announced). Opened Nov 2022 as HS HOTSSON Hotel Guadalajara Expo; interim Gran Hotel Expo Guadalajara by HNF; rebranded 2024 as Sheraton Guadalajara Expo.
Primary public web channel: https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/gdlse-sheraton-guadalajara-expo/overview/.
Property contact channels evidenced in the compile: telephone +52 33 3045 0101; email recepcion.gdldx@aimbridgelatam.com.

paragraphs: Ownership diligence separates the hotel asset, PropCo / title vehicle, economic owner or package owner, sponsor principals, and natural-person UBO. Operator and brand are not treated as ownership.

PROPCO: Inmobiliaria HNF, S. de R.L. de C.V. — status HIGH. Strongest PropCo/owner-vehicle evidence: project-era investor references, HNF naming, PROFECO adhesion contract (RFC IHN120620UZ3), notary/incorporation details. Deed folio for Mariano Otero 1510 not independently extracted.

ECONOMIC OWNER: HNF / Newton family sphere — status PROBABLE. Patricia Olivia Newton Frausto evidenced as former HNF chair/director; family presence continues. Current UBO / member register not obtained.
UBO: Not verified — status UNKNOWN. No shareholder/member register or title extract obtained.

For Sheraton Guadalajara Expo, the strongest public PropCo reading is Inmobiliaria HNF, S. de R.L. de C.V. (RFC IHN120620UZ3), supported by project-era investor references and PROFECO RPCA adhesion contract 5805-2025 for event-hall rental contracting tied to the property. Deed folio confirmation for Av. Mariano Otero 1510 remains an open registry item.
Natural-person UBO is not asserted. Probable sponsor or buyer principals are labeled PROBABLE where press names exist without registry confirmation.

Corporate / business contact path on the ownership compile: +52 81 1469 4177; olga.porras@aimbridge.com. Where Aimbridge emails appear on HNF PROFECO filings, they are disclosed as operator-operated contact paths on a PropCo instrument — not as proof that Aimbridge is the owner.

paragraphs: Operator diligence distinguishes current third-party management from former operators and from brand licensors.
CURRENT operator: Aimbridge LATAM (CURRENT; confidence HIGH). Listed on Aimbridge LATAM property pages and April 2026 portfolio PDF.
FORMER operator: CAPITALI Grupo Hotelero (FORMER; confidence HIGH). HS HOTSSON development/operator era. Exact handoff date to Aimbridge UNKNOWN; GM profile shift Apr 2024 is strong timing clue.

Aimbridge LATAM is a third-party management platform. Its presence on property pages and portfolio PDFs supports operated / managed relationships and does not convert Aimbridge into the economic owner or property company.

Sheraton-specific timing clue: General Manager Julieta Fregoso's professional profile shifts from HS HOTSSON GM through April 2024 to Sheraton Guadalajara Expo GM at Aimbridge LATAM from April 2024 — a strong operator-transition signal, not a substitute for the management agreement instrument.
